tpl: Immediately launches a grenade, dealing {0} ATK as Physical damage to all enemies hit and Stunning them for {1} seconds

The next attack buries a mine (lasts for 120 seconds) in a deployable tile within this unit's Attack Range; The mine will detonate when an enemy passes by it, dealing {0} Physical damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for {1} seconds
